title: 门店月度收入与费用偏离
context: 销售＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年每店每月，净销售、费用、费用率及过去3个月费用率（总费用/总净销售）；至少三个月才输出滚动率，缺失月份销售费用为0。
commonError: 直接平均各月费用率不能得到整体费用率。
mysqlSql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key>='2025-01'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), z AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.expense,0) expense FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id AND b.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) n3,SUM(expense) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) e3,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) k FROM z) SELECT store_id,month_key,net net_cents,expense expense_cents,ROUND(100.0*expense/NULLIF(net,0),2) expense_pct,CASE WHEN k=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*e3/NULLIF(n3,0),2) ELSE NULL END rolling_pct FROM p ORDER BY store_id,month_key
